{"code": "import numpy as np

# Manual t-test for biomarker change (valid cases only)
control_change = valid_data[valid_data['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change_clean']
treatment_change = valid_data[valid_data['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change_clean']

# Sample sizes
n_control = len(control_change)
n_treatment = len(treatment_change)

# Means
mean_control = control_change.mean()
mean_treatment = treatment_change.mean()

# Variances
var_control = control_change.var(ddof=1)
var_treatment = treatment_change.var(ddof=1)

# Standard error of difference
se_diff = np.sqrt(var_control/n_control + var_treatment/n_treatment)

# T-statistic
t_stat = (mean_treatment - mean_control) / se_diff

# Degrees of freedom (approximate)
df = (var_control/n_control + var_treatment/n_treatment)**2 / \
     ((var_control/n_control)**2/(n_control-1) + (var_treatment/n_treatment)**2/(n_treatment-1))

# Two-tailed p-value
p_val = 2 * (1 - t.cdf(abs(t_stat), df))

print(f'T-statistic: {t_stat:.4f}')
print(f'P-value: {p_val:.6f}')"}
